intro.zh: 我是上海科技大学电子科学与技术专业硕士研究生，本科毕业于上科大电子信息工程专业。我的研究兴趣在于触觉感知与机器人操作的交叉领域。这里记录我的学习笔记、项目与研究工作。
intro.en: I am a master's student in Electronic Science and Technology at ShanghaiTech University, having completed my bachelor's degree in Electronic Information Engineering there. My research interests sit at the intersection of tactile sensing and robotic manipulation. This site collects my study notes, projects, and research work.

lead.zh: 我的研究兴趣在于以触觉感知推进机器人操作。
lead.en: My research interests lie in pushing forward robotic manipulation with tactile sensing.

title.zh: Sampling（采样）：从蒙特卡洛到生成模型
title.en: Sampling: From Monte Carlo to Generative Models

excerpt.zh: 从逆变换与接受-拒绝采样出发，串联蒙特卡洛积分、重要性采样、MCMC、Diffusion 与 Flow Matching，整理核心公式及它们之间的联系。
excerpt.en: A Chinese study note connecting classical sampling, Monte Carlo integration, importance sampling, MCMC, diffusion, and flow matching. This English page is a brief reading guide.

body.en: This Chinese study note follows a path from inverse-transform and acceptance-rejection sampling to Monte Carlo integration, importance sampling, MCMC, diffusion, and flow matching. It emphasizes the reasoning behind each method and the connections between their probability and sampling views.

title.zh: RL-probability：概率、集中与马尔可夫动力学
title.en: RL-probability: Probability, Concentration, and Markov Dynamics

excerpt.zh: 第一讲完整笔记：从概率与条件期望、LLSE/MMSE 投影，到集中不等式、马尔可夫链、统计推断与贝叶斯学习。按章保留定义、定理条件、计算例子和共轭模型，连接价值估计、探索与 belief 更新。
excerpt.en: A standalone English write-up of the whole lecture: conditional expectation as the object of value, projection and LLSE/MMSE, Monte Carlo, LLN/CLT and concentration, Markov chains with stationarity and mixing, statistical inference with conjugate models, and Bayesian learning up to Thompson Sampling and POMDP beliefs.
